entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
Reason:
assess the market value of the land as on 01.01.2014 along with all the statutory benefits admissible under the 2013 Act.

However, the so-called award has been passed under the old Act completely overlooking the categorical directions contained in paragraph 9 of our order dated 12.09.2023.
2.
Consequently, award dated 09.09.2024 is hereby set aside.
The respondent no.3- the Prescribed Authority is directed to pass a fresh award strictly in terms of paragraph 9 of our order, within two weeks and submit a compliance affidavit to that effect.

The compensation amount to be determined under the new award shall be deposited with the Registry of this Court by the Lucknow Development Authority within two weeks from the date of passing of the award.

(ARJUN BISHT) (PREETHI T.C.)
